changelog:
Initial release of 24h-product-marketing skill for Zalo Shop-ready product blocks.

- Converts a single 24h.chichbong.com product URL into a short, professional Vietnamese summary (under 500 characters), a safer rewritten title, a marked-up price (30–50% increase), and main product thumbnail.
- Prioritizes direct reading from the product page; uses search fallback if direct access fails.
- Extracts and compresses only factual, sellable details suitable for product listings; strictly avoids exaggeration and sensitive ad terms.
- Automatically rewrites titles and descriptions to ensure ad safety and e-commerce compliance.
- Includes robust error handling: if key product details or images can’t be verified, outputs a clear notice with no fabricated information.
